cases.name: Keniqua Dachelle King
cases.about: King's family told ABC13 she was a giving woman with a big heart. The victim's mother, Vickie Gill, says she's devastated with the loss of her youngest daughter.
cases.narrative: On 11/29/2022, her body was found near FM 521 and FM 1462, and she had been shot 9 times in the head.
